label: WRONG
reason: Versioned codemods (v5/flatten-streamtext-file-properties.ts, v7/move-include-raw-chunks-to-include.ts) do default-export createTransformer(...), but every outlier is a shared helper in codemods/lib/ (createTransformer itself, the addAwaitFn/removeFacade factories that return createTransformer, insertCommentOnce), so the glob mixes helpers with codemods and new lib helpers would be falsely flagged. Hesitated with ACCEPT, since a new versioned codemod skipping the wrapper would be worth flagging.
